channel.title: Weekly Delight
channel.description: 5460 well-known recipes from around the world, explained step by step

item.title: Cowboy Pie
item.description: Cowboy pie with pork sausages, baked beans and smoky barbecue sauce under mashed potato and cheddar. Includes the filling and topping method.

item.title: Chocolate Concrete
item.description: Chocolate concrete is a cocoa biscuit traybake with a firm crumb and a sugared top. Includes mixing, baking and cooling instructions for squares.

item.title: Cheese and Herb Quick Bread
item.description: Cheese and herb quick bread made with yoghurt, garlic and bicarbonate of soda. A savoury loaf with no yeast, including its cooling instructions.

item.title: Chicken Cobbler
item.description: Chicken cobbler layers cooked chicken, broccoli and cheddar beneath a savoury biscuit topping. Includes baking cues and the required resting stage.

item.title: Hundreds and Thousands Biscuits
item.description: Hundreds and thousands biscuits with butter, rice flour and pink white-chocolate icing. Includes rolling, baking, cooling and decorating instructions.

item.title: Canneles
item.description: Canelés with a dark crisp shell and soft custard centre, baked for 60 minutes. Twelve cakes, ready in 1 hour 15 minutes plus overnight resting.

item.title: Lapin a la Moutarde
item.description: Rabbit in a mustard and cream sauce, cooked for 60 minutes. Four servings, ready in 1 hour 40 minutes.

item.title: Bourride
item.description: Bourride, a fish stew finished with garlic aioli, cooked for 30 minutes. Four servings, ready in 1 hour.

item.title: Tian Provencal
item.description: Tian provençal of sliced courgette, aubergine and tomato, baked for 45 minutes. Four servings, ready in 1 hour 20 minutes.

item.title: Pommes Anna
item.description: Pommes Anna, layered buttery potato slices baked into a crisp golden cake, baked for 50 minutes. Four servings, ready in 1 hour 10 minutes.

item.title: Pommes Dauphine
item.description: Pommes dauphine, mashed potato mixed with choux pastry and deep fried in batches. Six servings, ready in 1 hour 45 minutes to 1 hour 55 minutes.

item.title: Petits Pois a la Francaise
item.description: Petits pois à la française, peas braised with lettuce and spring onions, cooked for 20 minutes. Four servings, ready in 30 minutes.

item.description: Haricots verts amandine, green beans in browned butter and almonds, cooked for 10 minutes. Four servings, ready in 15 minutes.

item.description: Tarte aux fraises, strawberries on vanilla custard in a crisp pastry case, baked for 20 minutes. Eight servings, ready in 1 hour plus chilling.

item.title: Tarte aux Poireaux
item.description: Tarte aux poireaux, a leek and cream tart in shortcrust pastry, baked for 40 minutes. Six servings, ready in 1 hour 35 minutes to 1 hour 40 minutes.

item.description: Tarte à l'oignon, a sweet onion and cream tart in shortcrust pastry, baked for 40 minutes. Six servings, ready in 2 hours to 2 hours 5 minutes.

item.description: Paupiettes de veau, veal rolls with a herb stuffing braised in white wine, cooked for 1 hour. Four servings, ready in 1 hour 30 minutes.

item.description: Tournedos Rossini, fillet steak on fried bread with foie gras and Madeira sauce, cooked for 15 minutes. Two servings, ready in 35 minutes.
